decks.notes: This deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, with a heavy emphasis on disruption and removal spells to control the battlefield. By using creatures with strong abilities like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Feign Death provides additional control and manipulation options, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and exploit the opponent's weaknesses for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard using Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, while also disrupting opponents with hand disruption spells like Grief and Leyline Binding. The deck includes various ways to protect and support the reanimated creatures, such as Faithful Mending and Solitude. The goal is to create a fast and explosive combo that overwhelms the opponent with powerful creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Bone Shards to handle threats from the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while disrupting their strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to recur creatures and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for graveyard interaction and maintaining tempo. Overall, the key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on dealing damage to the opponent quickly and efficiently through a combination of direct damage spells and aggressive creatures. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent's life total while preventing them from gaining life or stabilizing the board. By utilizing low-cost spells and creatures with haste, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to develop their own game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack helps to bypass any potential defenses or life gain strategies the opponent may have.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. It also utilizes graveyard recursion with Dauthi Voidwalker and Undying Malice to keep putting pressure on the opponent. The deck's versatility allows for quick creature removal with Lightning Bolt and Terminate, as well as disrupting nonbasic lands with Blood Moon. Overall, the deck aims to establish board presence early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and disruption. By utilizing powerful creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Grief, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with disruptive spells such as Thoughtseize and Terminate, the deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect and recur key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Orcish Bowmasters offer additional ways to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of Blood Moon also adds an element of disruption against certain strategies.

The main concept of this deck is to combine various cards and spells in order to generate a large amount of mana and cast a series of spells in quick succession, known as "storming off." The deck utilizes a combination of cantrips, counterspells, and burn spells to control the game state while digging for combo pieces. It also includes cards that can create tokens or generate card advantage, like Shark Typhoon and Archmage's Charm. The ultimate goal is to create a lethal storm count, allowing the player to cast Flame of Anor and deal a significant amount of damage to the opponent.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively deploy a variety of low-cost creatures and spells to deal direct damage to the opponent. Using cards such as Mishra's Bauble, Lightning Bolt, and Monastery Swiftspear, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early on and maintain a fast tempo throughout the game. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Sprite Dragon, the deck can also benefit from graveyard interaction and spell synergy to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on utilizing versatile creatures and disruptive spells to maintain a constant pressure on the opponent. It aims to quickly establish a strong board presence with cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Tarmogoyf, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful synergy with cards like Call of the Death-Dweller and Witherbloom Command to generate value and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through Amulet of Vigor and lands like Tolaria West and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to ultimately cast Primeval Titan and search for key lands like Vesuva and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion. The deck also includes cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to help with land drops and fixing mana. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Summoner's Pact, the deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces for a powerful combo finish, utilizing the lands and abilities of Primeval Titan to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to combo off with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. It utilizes cards like Wall of Roots and Ignoble Hierarch to accelerate mana production and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Endurance and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board. With a mix of sacrifice outlets, recursion, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile and resilient combo strategy.

This deck focuses on casting free spells with cascade and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can consistently put powerful threats onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation. The goal is to quickly build a board presence and pressure the opponent into making mistakes, leading to a quick victory through aggressive plays and efficient use of resources.

This deck focuses on utilizing The Underworld Cookbook as a central engine to quickly fill the graveyard and enable powerful plays. By sacrificing creatures and artifacts, the deck can create advantage through cards like Persist and Mausoleum Secrets, while also utilizing the graveyard for recursion with Malakir Rebirth and Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Grief and Troll of Khazad-dûm to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Additionally, support cards like Pithing Needle and Shadowspear help control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also presenting threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly close out the game. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect and recur key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide card advantage. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and finish them off before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with threats. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's manabase and cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and enhance your own creatures. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of disruption and aggression.

The main focus of this UR Aggro Modern deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Force of Negation. The deck aims to control the board while dealing direct damage with cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Preordain and Consider to maintain card advantage and ensure consistent draws. The deck is designed to apply early pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game.
